# OctaSpace

> OctaSpace is a decentralized GPU cloud and compute marketplace. Rent high-performance GPUs
> (NVIDIA RTX 3090/4090, A100s, and 30+ other models) by the minute, run VPN and rendering
> workloads, or earn OCTA by sharing your own hardware. No subscriptions — pay-per-minute,
> settled on-chain.

## Key links

- Website: https://octa.space/
- Documentation: https://docs.octa.space/
- GPU marketplace (rent compute): https://marketplace.octa.space/
- API reference: https://api.octa.space/api-docs
- GitHub organization: https://github.com/octaspace
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/octa_space
- Contact: hello@octa.space

## Products

- **GPU marketplace**: rent bare-metal GPU machines by the minute; providers set their own prices.
  Live stats and per-GPU pricing: https://marketplace.octa.space/
- **OctaVPN**: pay-as-you-go decentralized VPN with multi-platform apps.
- **OctaRender**: distributed Blender rendering network.
- **Idle mining**: provider nodes automatically mine when not rented, so hardware is never idle.
- **OCTA token**: the network's settlement currency for compute, VPN, and rendering.

## Build with OctaSpace

- JavaScript/TypeScript SDK: https://github.com/octaspace/js-sdk (`npm install @octaspace/sdk`)
- Python SDK: https://github.com/octaspace/python-sdk (`pip install octaspace`)
- Go SDK: https://github.com/octaspace/go-sdk
- Ruby SDK: https://github.com/octaspace/ruby-sdk
- CLI (`octa`): https://github.com/octaspace/octa-cli — inspect accounts, rent machines,
  manage sessions, connect via VPN relays.
- Node software (`orc`): https://github.com/octaspace/orc — turn hardware into an
  OctaSpace service node.

## Quick start (JS SDK)

```ts
import { OctaClient } from '@octaspace/sdk'

const client = new OctaClient({ apiKey: process.env.OCTA_API_KEY })
const nodes = await client.nodes.list()
```

## Note

This is a community-maintained summary for AI assistants. For authoritative protocol
details (staking, eras, rewards), see https://docs.octa.space/ and the whitepaper at
https://github.com/octaspace/whitepaper.github.io.
